name: Weighted Sit-Up
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding the plate against your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your head, shoulders, and torso smoothly up off the floor until you sit tall over your hips.
Keep your feet grounded firmly without jerking the plate forward to create momentum.
Unroll your spine slowly back down to the floor under strict control before starting the next repetition.
tips: Move deliberately on the way down rather than collapsing rapidly onto your back.
Keep the plate against your chest from the first curl through the descent.
